documentation.name: PRD_0.md
documentation.summary: Foundational MVP product contract for Nuée: defines the shared vocabulary (project, bubble, discussion, document, project description, frozen context) and the core habit loop of focused discussion to user-approved bubble to bubble reuse. Establishes the principles every feature PRD must conform to and may not weaken, including explicit user approval before AI output becomes durable knowledge.

documentation.name: PRD_03.md
documentation.summary: Specifies Focused Discussions: a single visible modal above the canvas, immutable user and assistant messages, idempotent generation with retry of failed turns only, AI-generated titles with a deterministic placeholder fallback, and the last-activity ordering that drives the Discussions panel and the single Active discussion.

documentation.name: PRD_04.md
documentation.summary: Specifies Discussion Context: the user explicitly chooses bubbles and whole documents before a discussion starts, the current project description is always included, and the selection is captured as immutable frozen snapshots at creation time. Later edits or deletions of the source never alter an existing discussion, and there is no mutation path for context after creation.

documentation.name: DOCUMENT_OPERATIONS.md
documentation.summary: Production runbook for the MVP Document Library, specifying the trusted single-user deployment boundary, the paired SQLite/private-originals durability unit, format and size limits, ClamAV provisioning, lease recovery, cleanup, retention, and backup/restore procedures. Nine sections close with a release checklist covering data paths, HTTPS ingress, scanner health, single-instance operation, and log-redaction rules.

documentation.name: PRD_01.md
documentation.summary: Specifies the Project Workspace: minimal project creation (title plus short description, no questionnaire or AI-generated starter content), project routing and persistence, the description editor with debounced autosave, and the single right-side panel shell that switches between Discussions, Documents, Project, and Inspector views.

documentation.name: PRD_02.md
documentation.summary: Specifies the Bubble Canvas as Nuée's primary durable-memory surface: an effectively infinite pan/zoom canvas, bubble cards with title and summary preview, manual bubble creation and editing, symmetric manual links without drawn connector lines, multi-selection handoff for other features, deterministic Compact layout, and persistence of positions and viewport.

documentation.name: AGENTS.md
documentation.summary: Verbatim copy of CLAUDE.md, carrying the identical 16-section "Nuée Technical Direction" architectural boundary spec for the whole repository under the conventional AGENTS.md filename that tool-agnostic coding agents look for. It holds no independent content; the two files are explicitly required to be kept in sync.

documentation.name: PRD_05.md
documentation.summary: Specifies Knowledge Extraction, the bridge from temporary reasoning to durable memory: the user selects discussion messages and frozen-context items, the model returns exactly one structured proposal (title, summary, content), and the user reviews it before approving it as a new bubble, updating an existing bubble with optimistic-concurrency protection, or discarding it.

documentation.name: README.md
documentation.summary: Backend entry documentation, largely the stock NestJS starter README wrapped around a project-specific Configuration section that tabulates every validated environment variable — HTTP, CORS, SQLite path, AI provider/model and token budgets, and the full DOCUMENT_* processing and malware-scanner settings — with defaults and purpose.

documentation.name: CLAUDE.md
documentation.summary: "Nuée Technical Direction" — the authoritative architectural boundary document governing the entire repository, spanning 16 sections that fix workspace layout and root commands, cross-cutting constraints (incremental refactors, no redundant dependencies), per-feature ownership for both frontend and backend, and the discussion, document, persistence, HTTP API, operations, and security seams. It records boundaries rather than product requirements, and is meant to be updated only when a change deliberately moves one.

documentation.name: README.md
documentation.summary: Entry document for a Claude Design handoff bundle, describing the exported HTML/CSS/JS prototypes as visual references to be recreated rather than production code to be copied. Names the primary workspace-screen prototype and lists the bundle's contents.

documentation.name: README.md
documentation.summary: Unmodified `create-vite` React + TypeScript template README covering the two official React plugins, why the React Compiler is left disabled, and how to opt into type-aware ESLint rules. It carries no Nuée-specific guidance — the project's real architectural direction lives in the root CLAUDE.md.

documentation.name: PRD_06.md
documentation.summary: Specifies the Document Library: project-scoped upload with server-authoritative validation, private storage of the original under a server-generated key, malware scanning before text extraction, explicit processing states with retry, inspection in the Documents panel, and the readiness contract exposing only complete ready documents to Discussion Context.

documentation.name: PRD_07.md
documentation.summary: Specifies per-turn opt-in web search for discussions: a composer toggle shown only when the provider supports it, a provider-neutral search flag and citation contract on the ModelClient port, an OpenAI Responses API adapter mapping, and citations persisted immutably on the assistant message and rendered as sanitized links.

documentation.name: PRD_08.md
documentation.summary: Reworks the extraction request from PRD 05 into one deliberate Extract as bubble dialog with three ordered steps — what to include, optional free-text instructions, and a three-level detail choice — replacing whole-discussion selection with an explicit Select all and carrying the new parameters through to the prompt and the persisted attempt.

documentation.name: PRD_09.md
documentation.summary: Replaces PRD 04's four-surface context-selection flow with inline mentions in the draft composer: typing @ opens one searchable list of bubbles and documents, attachments become removable chips plus highlighted inline tokens, a persistent line counts what will freeze on send, and sending performs the handoff to the existing frozen badges.

list.name: Frontend Shell, Workspace & Canvas
list.description: The SPA entry chain (index.html, main.tsx, App.tsx) plus the frontend features that own project composition and spatial presentation — projects/ (creation and metadata), workspace/ (route-level panels and shared workspace state), canvas/ (pan, zoom, drag, selection, placement, viewport persistence) and bubbles/ (bubble content, links, validation, save status).

list.name: Frontend Knowledge Features
list.description: Client lifecycle for the three knowledge workflows: discussions/ (write-first drafts, composer and message states, retry, mentions, per-turn web search), documents/ (preflight, transfers, processing polling, context selection) and knowledge-extraction/ (extraction state machine, source and target selection, proposal review).

list.name: Frontend API Boundary & Shared Primitives
list.description: The cross-cutting frontend layer CLAUDE.md names explicitly: api/ is the only place fetch lives (client.ts transport plus one module per REST resource behind the api/index.ts barrel), alongside analytics.ts, utils/ helpers, and ui/ presentation primitives that carry no feature behavior.

list.name: Shared Contracts
list.description: The dependency-free @nuee/shared-types workspace: serialized request/response contracts and the validation limits both tiers import so client and server never redeclare a limit — the only code both frontend and backend depend on.

list.name: Backend Project & Content Domain
list.description: NestJS feature modules owning the persisted project graph — projects/ (lifecycle, metadata, viewport), bubbles/ (content, placement, links, the REST endpoints exposed under /projects/:projectId) and documents/ (upload validation, private original storage, malware scanning, extraction leases, inspection reads) — each keeping its own controller, service, repository port, SQLite implementation, migrations, types and unit specs together.

list.name: Backend Discussions & AI Workflow
list.description: The model-facing half of the backend: discussions/ (immutable message turns, idempotent generation attempts, frozen-context persistence, last_activity_at ordering), discussion-context/ (assembling the FrozenContext package from project sources), knowledge-extraction/ (extraction workflow, prompts, resolution) and ai/ (the provider-neutral ModelClient port, adapters, capability discovery, deterministic test client).

list.name: Backend Platform & Persistence
list.description: Cross-cutting backend infrastructure: the main.ts bootstrap and app.module.ts composition root, the single typed configuration path, and database/ — the application-scoped DatabaseProvider owning the shared node:sqlite connection, the ordered migration runner authoritative over schema_migrations, and the transaction helper every feature repository builds on.

list.name: Standalone Test Suites
list.description: The two test suites that live outside feature folders: frontend/tests/ Vitest component, hook and API-client specs covering failure, retry, abort and stale-response branches, and backend/test/ Jest e2e specs driving real HTTP journeys. Unit specs co-located beside the code they cover stay in their own feature layer.

list.name: Build Tooling & Configuration
list.description: The npm-workspaces root manifest and per-workspace build configuration — Vite, the split frontend tsconfigs (app/node/test), ESLint flat configs, Nest CLI and backend tsconfigs — plus local analysis tooling settings. No container, CI, or infrastructure-as-code files exist in this repository.

list.name: Documentation & Product Specs
list.description: Written knowledge about the system rather than the system itself: the CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md architectural direction that defines the ownership model used by these layers, workspace READMEs, the document-storage operations runbook, the ten PRD chapters in shared/PRD/, and the design flow artifacts.

file:frontend/src/api/discussions.ts.name: discussions.ts

file:frontend/src/api/projects.ts.name: projects.ts

file:frontend/tests/documentsApi.test.ts.name: documentsApi.test.ts

file:frontend/tests/knowledgeExtractions.name: knowledgeExtractionsApi.test.ts

document:CLAUDE.md.name: CLAUDE.md
document:CLAUDE.md.summary: "Nuée Technical Direction" — the authoritative architectural boundary document governing the entire repository, spanning 16 sections that fix workspace layout and root commands, cross-cutting constraints (incremental refactors, no redundant dependencies), per-feature ownership for both frontend and backend, and the discussion, document, persistence, HTTP API, operations, and security seams. It records boundaries rather than product requirements, and is meant to be updated only when a change deliberately moves one.

document:AGENTS.md.name: AGENTS.md
document:AGENTS.md.summary: Verbatim copy of CLAUDE.md, carrying the identical 16-section "Nuée Technical Direction" architectural boundary spec for the whole repository under the conventional AGENTS.md filename that tool-agnostic coding agents look for. It holds no independent content; the two files are explicitly required to be kept in sync.

config:package.json.name: package.json
config:package.json.summary: Root npm-workspaces manifest for the private `nuee` monorepo, declaring the `shared`, `frontend`, and `backend` workspaces and the aggregate `dev`, `build`, `lint`, `test`, and `test:e2e` scripts that fan out to them. `dev` runs the Vite frontend and NestJS backend side by side via `concurrently`, its only devDependency.

document:backend/DOCUMENT_OPERATIONS.md.name: DOCUMENT_OPERATIONS.md
document:backend/DOCUMENT_OPERATIONS.md.summary: Production runbook for the MVP Document Library, specifying the trusted single-user deployment boundary, the paired SQLite/private-originals durability unit, format and size limits, ClamAV provisioning, lease recovery, cleanup, retention, and backup/restore procedures. Nine sections close with a release checklist covering data paths, HTTPS ingress, scanner health, single-instance operation, and log-redaction rules.

document:backend/README.md.name: README.md
document:backend/README.md.summary: Backend entry documentation, largely the stock NestJS starter README wrapped around a project-specific Configuration section that tabulates every validated environment variable — HTTP, CORS, SQLite path, AI provider/model and token budgets, and the full DOCUMENT_* processing and malware-scanner settings — with defaults and purpose.

config:backend/nest-cli.json.name: nest-cli.json
config:backend/nest-cli.json.summary: NestJS CLI configuration pointing the schematics collection at @nestjs/schematics, setting the source root to src, and clearing the output directory on each build.

config:backend/package.json.name: package.json
config:backend/package.json.summary: Backend workspace manifest declaring the NestJS 11 / Express runtime, the OpenAI SDK and pdfjs-dist processing dependencies, and the @nuee/shared-types workspace contract. Scripts chain a shared-package build before every build/start, and the inline Jest config maps @nuee/shared-types straight to shared/src so tests never need a prebuilt dist.

config:backend/tsconfig.build.json.name: tsconfig.build.json
config:backend/tsconfig.build.json.summary: Production build variant of the backend TypeScript config; extends tsconfig.json and excludes node_modules, the e2e test directory, dist, and all *.spec.ts files from emitted output.

config:backend/tsconfig.json.name: tsconfig.json
config:backend/tsconfig.json.summary: Base TypeScript compiler configuration for the backend: nodenext modules and resolution, ES2023 target, decorator metadata emission for NestJS dependency injection, incremental builds into dist, and a partial-strictness set (strictNullChecks, noImplicitAny, strictBindCallApply, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch).

document:frontend/README.md.name: README.md
document:frontend/README.md.summary: Unmodified `create-vite` React + TypeScript template README covering the two official React plugins, why the React Compiler is left disabled, and how to opt into type-aware ESLint rules. It carries no Nuée-specific guidance — the project's real architectural direction lives in the root CLAUDE.md.

file:frontend/index.html.name: index.html
file:frontend/index.html.summary: Vite entry document for the client-rendered SPA: declares the `#root` mount point and loads `/src/main.tsx` as an ES module. Also preconnects to Google Fonts and pulls in IBM Plex Sans/Mono, which back the app's visual language.

config:frontend/package.json.name: package.json
config:frontend/package.json.summary: Frontend workspace manifest pinning React 19, Tailwind 4 (via the `@tailwindcss/vite` plugin), lucide-react icons, and the workspace-local `@nuee/shared-types` contract package. Its scripts define the whole frontend toolchain: `vite` dev server, `tsc -b && vite build`, `eslint .`, and `vitest run --environment jsdom`.

config:frontend/tsconfig.json.name: tsconfig.json
config:frontend/tsconfig.json.summary: Solution-style root tsconfig holding no files of its own; it exists purely to fan out project references to the app, test, and node-tooling configs so `tsc -b` builds all three.

config:frontend/tsconfig.app.json.name: tsconfig.app.json
config:frontend/tsconfig.app.json.summary: Compiles the SPA sources under `src/` in strict, no-emit bundler mode with `react-jsx`, ES2023/DOM libs, and Vite client types. Critically, it maps the `@nuee/shared-types` path alias straight to `../shared/src/index.ts`, so frontend type-checking reads shared source and never depends on a prebuilt `shared/dist`.

config:frontend/tsconfig.node.json.name: tsconfig.node.json
config:frontend/tsconfig.node.json.summary: Separate strict compilation unit for build-time tooling that runs under Node rather than the browser — its `include` is scoped to `vite.config.ts` alone, with `nodenext` module resolution and Node types instead of DOM.

config:frontend/tsconfig.test.json.name: tsconfig.test.json
config:frontend/tsconfig.test.json.summary: Thin extension of the app config for the `tests/` directory, adding Node types alongside the Vite client types so jsdom-based Vitest suites can use both browser and Node APIs.

document:shared/PRD/PRD_0.md.name: PRD_0.md
document:shared/PRD/PRD_0.md.summary: Foundational MVP product contract for Nuée: defines the shared vocabulary (project, bubble, discussion, document, project description, frozen context) and the core habit loop of focused discussion to user-approved bubble to bubble reuse. Establishes the principles every feature PRD must conform to and may not weaken, including explicit user approval before AI output becomes durable knowledge.

document:shared/PRD/PRD_01.md.name: PRD_01.md
document:shared/PRD/PRD_01.md.summary: Specifies the Project Workspace: minimal project creation (title plus short description, no questionnaire or AI-generated starter content), project routing and persistence, the description editor with debounced autosave, and the single right-side panel shell that switches between Discussions, Documents, Project, and Inspector views.

document:shared/PRD/PRD_02.md.name: PRD_02.md
document:shared/PRD/PRD_02.md.summary: Specifies the Bubble Canvas as Nuée's primary durable-memory surface: an effectively infinite pan/zoom canvas, bubble cards with title and summary preview, manual bubble creation and editing, symmetric manual links without drawn connector lines, multi-selection handoff for other features, deterministic Compact layout, and persistence of positions and viewport.

document:shared/PRD/PRD_03.md.name: PRD_03.md
document:shared/PRD/PRD_03.md.summary: Specifies Focused Discussions: a single visible modal above the canvas, immutable user and assistant messages, idempotent generation with retry of failed turns only, AI-generated titles with a deterministic placeholder fallback, and the last-activity ordering that drives the Discussions panel and the single Active discussion.

document:shared/PRD/PRD_04.md.name: PRD_04.md
document:shared/PRD/PRD_04.md.summary: Specifies Discussion Context: the user explicitly chooses bubbles and whole documents before a discussion starts, the current project description is always included, and the selection is captured as immutable frozen snapshots at creation time. Later edits or deletions of the source never alter an existing discussion, and there is no mutation path for context after creation.

document:shared/PRD/PRD_05.md.name: PRD_05.md
document:shared/PRD/PRD_05.md.summary: Specifies Knowledge Extraction, the bridge from temporary reasoning to durable memory: the user selects discussion messages and frozen-context items, the model returns exactly one structured proposal (title, summary, content), and the user reviews it before approving it as a new bubble, updating an existing bubble with optimistic-concurrency protection, or discarding it.

document:shared/PRD/PRD_06.md.name: PRD_06.md
document:shared/PRD/PRD_06.md.summary: Specifies the Document Library: project-scoped upload with server-authoritative validation, private storage of the original under a server-generated key, malware scanning before text extraction, explicit processing states with retry, inspection in the Documents panel, and the readiness contract exposing only complete ready documents to Discussion Context.

document:shared/PRD/PRD_07.md.name: PRD_07.md
document:shared/PRD/PRD_07.md.summary: Specifies per-turn opt-in web search for discussions: a composer toggle shown only when the provider supports it, a provider-neutral search flag and citation contract on the ModelClient port, an OpenAI Responses API adapter mapping, and citations persisted immutably on the assistant message and rendered as sanitized links.

document:shared/PRD/PRD_08.md.name: PRD_08.md
document:shared/PRD/PRD_08.md.summary: Reworks the extraction request from PRD 05 into one deliberate Extract as bubble dialog with three ordered steps — what to include, optional free-text instructions, and a three-level detail choice — replacing whole-discussion selection with an explicit Select all and carrying the new parameters through to the prompt and the persisted attempt.

document:shared/PRD/PRD_09.md.name: PRD_09.md
document:shared/PRD/PRD_09.md.summary: Replaces PRD 04's four-surface context-selection flow with inline mentions in the draft composer: typing @ opens one searchable list of bubbles and documents, attachments become removable chips plus highlighted inline tokens, a persistent line counts what will freeze on send, and sending performs the handoff to the existing frozen badges.
